title: Skydive Tecumseh
specs: One of few US dropzones offering 18,000 feet jumps with oxygen
Tandem instructors hold USPA Tandem Instructor Certification and FAA Class III medical certificate
Minimum age 18 years with government-issued photo ID required
Weight limit 225 lbs if under 5'9"; up to 240 lbs with $25 surcharge if taller than 5'9"
Guests must be physically fit to withstand the physical requirements
Disabilities accommodated case-by-case with prior evaluation appointment
Group rates: 5-9 people save $10 each; 20+ people organizer jumps free and save $30 each

services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: If you dream of becoming a licensed skydiver and live in the Detroit, Ann Arbor, Lansing, or Jackson area, Skydive Tecumseh is the dropzone for you! Skydive Tecumseh offers the most comprehensive suite of Skydive Training Courses in Michigan. Our highly experienced team of USPA-certified instructors will guide you every step of the way through your training course. If you decide to sign up for our AFF program you can rest assured that our #1 priority is helping you become a confident, safety-minded, independent skydiver. services.desc: Since 1964, Skydive Tecumseh has been Michigan’s premier dropzone and the destination for college and university groups from all over the state and beyond. We have hosted Outdoor Adventure programs, fraternities, sororities, club socials, and collegiate fundraising events. We have garnered this trust because of our world-class, purpose-built facilities, professionalism, and passion for what we do! Skydive Tecumseh is unlike most skydiving centers in the United States. Our operation was built exclusively for group skydiving - we are not an old hangar with old planes and tired equipment.
